name: My CKE Button
description: Lets admins define custom named button/text styles through a form and exposes them as a CKEditor (CKEditor 4) plugin button that applies the configured styles.
project_description:
The My CKE Button module makes it possible to create custom button styles, to be used inside CKEditor, or to create one-time styles inside in it's style selection dialog.

 Each style contains six colors: text, background and border colors, and their hover versions.

There are also three different configurable properties, being the border radius, border width and padding.

 These button styles can be inserted in CKEditor.

 In case you only want to create a style for one button, you can also declare it at the same place you would select a button style.
